shots.title: A false green is not a repair
shots.narration: A repair can pass a nominal test and still fail when motor load, sensor delay, and surge timing shift together. BREAKSHIFT is a simulated maintenance bay for challenging AI repair proposals before trusting a green light.

shots.title: Recorded Meta perception
shots.narration: Here, SAM 3.1 tracks components across a synthetic seventeen frame clip. Muse Wonder supplies the recorded inspection proposal. These are retained model outputs replayed locally, not new live calls. Worker photo intake is separate from engineering verification.

shots.title: Proposal into a typed repair twin
shots.narration: A recorded Muse Spark diagnosis offers bounded repair options. The compiler turns a selected option into typed parameters and checks the declared workcell context. The Repair Twin visualizes the modeled run. A convincing explanation alone cannot clear the repair.

shots.title: Nominal pass, envelope failure
shots.narration: That green covered one nominal scenario. Now challenge a separate versioned reference across the uncertainty envelope. Nominal peak is fifteen fifty four point five watts. Worst case reaches seventeen twenty two point five watts, with forty milliseconds timing error. Only four of sixteen corners pass. The reference is refuted.

shots.title: Recorded Muse repair challenged
shots.narration: The recorded Muse Spark patch lowers arm power, slows the belt, separates surges, and compensates sensor delay. All sixteen corners and the analytic bound now pass in this model. Worst peak is fourteen hundred seventy point eight watts. Worst timing error is twenty milliseconds. Job duration is twenty three hundred fifty milliseconds, leaving only fifty milliseconds of margin.

shots.title: Changed assumptions withdraw the green
shots.narration: Now change the sensor delay. The green result immediately becomes stale, and export locks. Rechecking the harder envelope refutes this same patch. Restore the declared assumptions and verify again. Success belongs to a specific plan and context, not to the model's reputation.

shots.title: Export and independently replay
shots.narration: Download the experiment and review that same file. The browser recomputes the outcome without applying it to the workcell. A checksum binds the contents, but does not authenticate the author. Saved evidence is replayable, and physical repair remains unverified.

shots.title: Peak watts are not total watt-hours
shots.narration: The energy comparison exposes the tradeoff. Nominal peak drops by two hundred twenty six point five watts, but the batch takes seven hundred fifty milliseconds longer and consumes more modeled energy. Lower peak demand is not a claim of lower electricity bills.

shots.title: Reproduce the evidence
shots.narration: The public Apache licensed repository runs offline with Node alone. No package install or API key is needed. These are actual local test results. BREAKSHIFT makes AI repair proposals falsifiable and replayable. Simulation evidence is never physical machine clearance.
